Lewis Machine and Tool LM308MWS: "Best at the Basics" - Small Arms Review, Volume 19 No. 10 (December 2015)

weapons.name: MK11 Mod 0 DMR
weapons.source_note: KAC factory military operator's manual for the Mk 11 Mod 0, Section II-Navy: Mk 11 Mod 0 Equipment Description reads verbatim: "Barrel Rifling and Twist: 20" barrel with 5 grooves, right-hand twist with 1 turn in 11 inches (279 mm)." Gives 1 turn in 11 in = 279.4 mm per turn, five grooves, right-hand. The corpus lead of 285.8 mm (1:11.25) is not supported by this maker document.

weapons.name: LM308MWS Rifle
weapons.source_note: Small Arms Review, LM308MWS review, states verbatim: "the chrome lined, chrome moly 1-10″ found on the LM308MWS", and of the reviewed rifle: "hard chrome lining over the 1-10” twist rifled bore", and "The 1-10 twist rate of the rifle". Model named in the text. Gives 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm per turn. Specialist trade publication quoting the maker's specification; the stainless LM308SSR barrel is a different model at 1:11.25.

weapons.name: MARS-H 300 BLK Rifle
weapons.source_note: LMT Defense manufacturer product page for the 16" .300 Blackout barrel states verbatim: "16″ 300 Blackout Chrome Lined 1:7″ RH twist barrel", and the Specs table gives "Caliber .300 BLK", "Rifling Twist Rate 1:7″". Gives 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm per turn, right-hand. Caveat: LMT catalogues .300 BLK on the MRP-L platform and has no large-frame MARS-H model in .300 BLK, so the listed model name is imprecise; the value is LMT's published .300 BLK twist.

weapons.name: Mountain Eagle .300 WM Bolt-action Rifle
weapons.source_note: Magnum Research Mountain Eagle Owner's Manual, Technical Data / TWIST RATE table lists verbatim: ".300 Win Mag   1 in 10". Gives 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm per turn for the .300 Winchester Magnum barrel. (The same table lists .300 Wby Mag, .338 Win Mag, .340 Wby Mag and .30-06 at 1 in 10.)
